headline: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave flaws exploited; OpenSSH and Barracuda ESG KEV deadlines this week; iPhone exploit kits spread via Instagram ads

bullets.text: Changed: Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320, XXE) and Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder (CVE-2026-111793) are actively exploited despite available patches. CISA added both to KEV on 11-10 with a 11-24 deadline.

Due 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (root access) are due 11-13.

Leaked exploit kits are hitting employees' iPhones via an Instagram ad (iVerify report); no CVE or fixed iOS release is named. Chrome's eighth exploited zero-day of 2026 (CVE-2026-125350) and Outlook CVE-2026-124194 are due 11-24.

Still active: SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL, 4 outlets); AhsayCBS CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 exploited to drop a Python backdoor; Xen Orchestra auth bypass exploited to hijack VM servers; N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days.

AI and cloud supply chain: Fireworks AI breach widened to customer datasets, model weights and Notion AI chats; SGLang RCE used to breach NEAR AI; over a dozen organizations hit via Qubole; trusted AWS access abused across multiple cloud environments.

Breaches: SberSpasibo's 3,288,711 accounts added to Have I Been Pwned; Nitori says 37.6M customer records stolen; Vanderbilt hit by BYOD ransomware (5 outlets). 300 malicious packages in 7 days, mostly npm; the week ran 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 before 11-13 and check appliances for root compromise.
If you run Cisco BroadWorks or Openwave Webtop, apply the available patches now (CVE-2026-20320, CVE-2026-111793) and review logs.
Apply SAP's November patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws, and patch or isolate AhsayCBS and Xen Orchestra servers.
Update Chrome (CVE-2026-125350), Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) and iOS fleet-wide; warn staff about malicious Instagram ads.
If you use Fireworks AI or Qubole, rotate API keys and review access logs; review AWS cross-account trust and AssumeRole activity.
